## Case studies

- [Salesforce AI Skills Programme](https://kamalraj21.github.io/contentcraft/projects/salesforce-ai-skills/): Ten production AI Slackbot skills automating the documentation lifecycle; 80% faster first drafts, 70% shorter review cycles.
- [Headless Documentation & MCP](https://kamalraj21.github.io/contentcraft/projects/headless-docs/): Docs-as-code to GitHub-as-headless-CMS migration at Intel, plus a working open-source MCP prototype serving docs to AI agents.
- [Intel OpenVINO Developer Docs](https://kamalraj21.github.io/contentcraft/projects/intel-openvino/): Full information architecture for two AI inference toolchains.
- [Enterprise Documentation Redesign](https://kamalraj21.github.io/contentcraft/projects/documentation-redesign/): Fragmented docs to unified task-based hub; +35% satisfaction.
- [Microlearning at Intel](https://kamalraj21.github.io/contentcraft/projects/microlearning/): Dense docs into 5-minute interactive modules; 50% less learning time.
- [DocPilot × IceCream](https://kamalraj21.github.io/contentcraft/projects/docpilot-icecream/): AI agents + CI/CD generating full API docs for a 10,000-star Python library.
